title: Deep learning on resting 12-lead ECG predicts angiographic coronary artery disease
summary: A deep-learning model was developed on 16,476 patients with an ECG within 90 days before coronary angiography. In cross-validation AUC was 91.4%, and in an external validation set it reached PPV 82.5%, NPV 88.1% and AUC 92.4% for clinically significant CAD. The study is retrospective and limited to patients referred for angiography.

evidence.tested: Tenfold cross-validation plus an external validation set against angiographic stenosis criteria.
evidence.unknown: External cohort size and performance in unselected populations are not stated. Abstract-based; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A deep-learning model predicted significant coronary stenosis from a resting ECG.
